name: Opening the Arts
description: The process by which a parens opens a Gifted apprentice to the Hermetic Arts; apprenticeship legally begins only once it is done, and it may destroy, maintain, or convert the apprentice's Supernatural Abilities.

name: Supernatural Ability
description: Non-Hermetic magical abilities that many Gifted children possess; they raise the Intellego Vim Lab Total needed to Open the Arts and can be destroyed, kept, or converted into Hermetic Virtues.

name: Hermetic Virtue
description: Virtues tied to Hermetic magic; they can be taught by a parens who has them, with a Target Level of 15 for Minor and 21 for Major, and converted from Supernatural Abilities.

name: Hermetic Flaw
description: Flaws tied to Hermetic magic; including one when teaching a Hermetic Virtue gives a bonus, and they are gained through learning Virtues or uncontrolled Twilight and are permanent.

name: Greater Immunity
description: A Major Supernatural Virtue with no matching Supernatural Ability; it requires an Intellego Vim Lab Total of 30 to Open the Arts.

name: Dowsing
description: A Supernatural Ability used as an example for how Supernatural Abilities stack when Opening the Arts.

name: Skinchanger
description: A Supernatural Virtue that might convert into a Minor Magical Focus with self-transformation when the Arts are Opened.

name: Magical Focus
description: A Hermetic Virtue concentrating magical skill on a narrow area; Skinchanger may convert into a Minor Magical Focus, and the Verditius apprentice has a Major Magical Focus (Metal).

name: Magic Sensitivity
description: A Supernatural Virtue that might convert into an Affinity with Intellego or Vim.

name: Affinity with Art
description: A Virtue that improves progress in one Art or Ability; a Supernatural Virtue like Magic Sensitivity may convert into an Affinity with Intellego or Vim.

name: The Gift
description: The ability to work magic; it imposes a social penalty that Parma Magica negates, and its loss is the main reason apprentices fail. The term is believed to originate from Bonisagus' letters to Trianoma.

name: Parens
description: The master who trains an apprentice in Hermetic magic; plural parentes, sometimes addressed as pater or mater.

name: Filius
description: Hermetic title meaning son (filia, daughter), used by magi after apprenticeship for a magus trained by a given parens.

name: Adolescentia
description: The stage of life from 15 to 21, a time of service when an apprentice knows enough to assist his master in the lab.

name: Discipulus
description: Latin term for an apprentice during apprenticeship; discipula for a female, plurals discipuli and discipulae.

name: Dominus
description: Term meaning master or lord used by an apprentice for his master; domina for a maga.

name: Frater
description: Term meaning brother, used for a fellow male taught Hermetic magic by the apprentice's master; soror for a female.

name: Infantia
description: The period of an apprentice's life before being accepted by a master, meaning infancy.

name: Magister
description: Term for an apprentice's teacher or tutor, most often applied to mundane teachers, also used in universities.

name: Pueritia
description: The early stages of an apprentice's education, generally associated with childhood (ages 8 to 14).

name: Tiro
description: Term meaning young soldier or beginner, used by apprentices for each other and derisively by older magi.

name: Spontaneous Magic
description: Magic cast without a known formula; an apprentice can cast it once her Arts are Opened, though less reliably than a cantation.

name: Formulaic Spell
description: Spells learned in advance; a low-level formulaic spell known by an apprentice is often called a cantation.

name: Casting Tablets
description: Tablets held by a covenant that an apprentice can read and cast from if she has Artes Liberales 1 and Latin 4.

name: Artes Liberales
description: Academic Ability of reading and the liberal arts; apprentices generally reach score 1 by adolescence.

name: Latin
description: Language Ability required to work magic effectively; apprentices typically reach Latin 4.

name: Magic Theory
description: Arcane Ability for understanding Hermetic magic; needed to assist in and create laboratories.

name: Technique
description: The five Hermetic Arts of action; a newly Opened apprentice has 0 in each.

name: Form
description: The ten Hermetic Arts of subject; Bonisagus advised masters to favor the Forms first for the student's protection.

name: Hermetic Arts
description: The fifteen Techniques and Forms of Hermetic magic, which must be taught one-on-one from magus to apprentice.

name: Wizard's War
description: Legally sanctioned conflict between magi, in which an apprentice, as property, is fair game to be taken or destroyed.

name: Wizard's March
description: Legally sanctioned action against a magus in which his property, including apprentices, may be targeted.

name: Low Crime
description: A lesser Hermetic offense, such as keeping a Gifted lab assistant, fostering without instruction, or abandoning an apprentice.

name: High Crime
description: A serious Hermetic offense, such as teaching the final key of Parma Magica before the Oath of Hermes is sworn.

name: Code of Hermes
description: The laws of the Order of Hermes, which protect an apprentice only as the parens' property and give the apprentice no appeal against his master.

name: Peripheral Code
description: Body of Hermetic legal precedent; it requires a magus to teach his apprentice for one season every year.

name: Bonisagus
description: Founder of the Order whose letters to Trianoma are believed to be the source of the traditional teaching schedule for apprentices.

name: Trianoma
description: Recipient of Bonisagus' letters describing apprentice training; also gives her name to Trianoma apprentices of House Bonisagus.

name: Parma Magica
description: The Hermetic magic resistance; its final key is taught only after the Oath of Hermes is sworn, and it negates the Gift's social penalty.

name: The Gauntlet
description: The test each parens sets his apprentice to decide whether she is ready to become a maga; after three failures House Quaesitor administers one.

name: Gifted Lab Assistant
description: A Gifted child kept as a lab helper without having her Arts Opened; most Tribunals declare this practice a low crime.

name: Order of Hermes
description: The society of Hermetic magi, whose Code governs apprentices and which apprentices join after swearing the Oath.

name: Tribunal
description: Hermetic regional governing assembly that judges crimes, can declare apprentices forfeit, and meets every few years.

name: House Tytalus
description: Hermetic House whose apprenticeship is cruel; apprentices challenge their master for their Gauntlet when they feel ready.

name: House Bonisagus
description: Hermetic House with the legal privilege of taking apprentices from other magi and sworn to spread magical knowledge; its apprentices pass an oral examination.

name: Fosterage
description: The practice of magi trading apprentices for short periods, technically a low crime if personal instruction is not also given.

name: Heir
description: A Flaw suggested for an apprentice character who stands to inherit property, as in the Inheritance story seed.

name: Close Family Ties
description: A Flaw representing close bonds to family members, suggested for an apprentice tied to his uncle.

name: Divine Aura
description: A holy aura such as that of the monastery in the Inheritance story seed, with an aura of 4 that hinders magic.

name: House Verditius
description: Mystery Cult House focused on making magical items; it Initiates apprentices right after Opening their Arts and requires an apprentice piece as Gauntlet.

name: Verditius Magic
description: The free House Virtue of Verditius, an Outer Mystery into which apprentices are initiated.

name: Cautious Sorcerer
description: A Virtue held by the sample Verditius apprentice.

name: Weak Spontaneous Magic
description: A Hermetic Flaw held by the sample Verditius apprentice.

name: Hunchback
description: A Flaw held by the sample Verditius apprentice.

name: Slow Caster
description: A Hermetic Flaw held by the sample Verditius apprentice.

name: Apprentice
description: The Free Social Status Virtue for Hermetic apprentices, replaced by Failed Apprentice if the Gift is lost.

name: Failed Apprentice
description: A Minor Social Status Virtue gained when an apprentice loses the Gift, replacing Apprentice.

name: Craft: Goldsmith
description: Craft Ability held by the sample Verditius apprentice.

name: Brawl
description: Combat Ability held by the sample Verditius apprentice.

name: Guile
description: Social Ability of deception held by the sample Verditius apprentice.

name: Native Language
description: The character's mother tongue Ability.

name: Stealth
description: Ability of moving unseen, held by the sample Verditius apprentice.

name: Mischievous Childhood
description: A childhood template used as the starting point for the sample Verditius apprentice.

name: Outer Mystery
description: The initial Mystery of a Mystery Cult House, through which apprentices gain their free House Virtue by Initiation.

name: Mystery Cult
description: Esoteric cults in the Order; Mystery Cult Houses grant House Virtues through Initiation, and a hidden Mystery Cult includes the dream witches.

name: Initiation
description: The process of learning Mystery Cult Virtues, sometimes involving Ordeals; Outer Mystery initiation takes a season.

name: Ordeal
description: A Flaw accepted during Mystery initiation to add a bonus to learning a Mystery Cult Virtue.

name: Teaching Source Quality
description: Communication + Teaching + 3 + bonuses; compared to a Target Level when teaching a Hermetic Virtue.

name: Communication
description: A Characteristic used in the Teaching Source Quality.

name: Teaching
description: Ability used to teach others; a trainer does not need it but a teacher does.

name: House Virtue
description: The free Minor Hermetic Virtue each magus receives from his House, gained through 10 seasons of one-on-one interaction or Outer Mystery initiation.

name: Societates
description: Group of Hermetic Houses including House Ex Miscellanea, three of which follow the 10-season House Virtue rule.

name: True Lineages
description: Group of four Hermetic Houses whose apprentices gain the House Virtue through 10 seasons of interaction.

name: House Ex Miscellanea
description: Societas House whose apprentices receive a package of a Minor Hermetic Virtue, Major non-Hermetic Virtue and Major Hermetic Flaw, and which has no formal Gauntlet.

name: House Bjornaer
description: Mystery Cult House that Initiates an apprentice's Heartbeast at the Ritual of Twelve Years and recognizes apprentices as magi once they assume their heartbeast.

name: Heartbeast
description: The animal nature of a Bjornaer magus, Initiated during apprenticeship.

name: Ritual of Twelve Years
description: The Bjornaer ritual at which an apprentice's Heartbeast is Initiated.

name: House Criamon
description: Mystery Cult House whose apprentices are accepted as magi once asked the Riddle of the Magus.

name: House Merinita
description: Mystery Cult House interested in faeries and nature; Gauntlets involve faerie roads and regiones.

name: House Flambeau
description: Hermetic House whose House Virtue is Puissant Perdo or Puissant Ignem, and whose apprentices undergo a stylized public Gauntlet.

name: Puissant Art
description: A Hermetic Virtue boosting one Art; House Flambeau offers Puissant Perdo or Puissant Ignem as its House Virtue.

name: Inherited Flaw
description: A Flaw chosen at character generation that develops later in the character's life, such as Suppressed Gift.

name: Twilight
description: Temporary Twilight episodes, when uncontrolled, can bestow Hermetic Flaws; a failed Twilight comprehension can even cost the Gift.

name: Deficiency
description: Hermetic Deficiency Flaw that may be gained during the Opening of the Arts.

name: Realm of Magic
description: The Magic Realm; its creatures are least interested in adolescents.

name: Faerie Realm
description: The realm of faeries, which take keen interest in adolescents; a faerie may whisk a youth into it.

name: Divine Realm
description: The realm of the Divine; divine creatures and saints aid adolescents who seek help.

name: Mythic Europe
description: The setting of Ars Magica.

name: Trivium
description: The first stage of medieval learning, taught to future lawyers and clerics.

name: Profession: Scribe
description: Profession Ability often taught by tutors rather than magi.

name: Gentle Gift
description: A form of the Gift without the social penalty.

name: Blatant Gift
description: A form of the Gift with a -6 social penalty.

name: Turbulence
description: Uncontrolled magical outbursts of young Gifted characters, common in stressful lab seasons and classrooms.

name: Summa
description: A type of book for study; e.g. a Corpus summa in a covenant library.

name: Tractatus
description: A type of book for study, alongside summae.

name: Training
description: A method of instruction for Abilities only, not needing the Teaching Ability; counts as a season of one-on-one instruction.

name: King Arthur
description: Legendary king whose stories are popular in the 13th century.

name: Merlin
description: Arthur's mystical companion, master of self-transformation spells and prophecy, who taught magic to Nimiane.

name: Nimiane
description: Young damsel to whom Merlin taught all his secrets in eight days, recorded in a secret journal.

name: The Book of Nimiane
description: The legendary journal in which Nimiane recorded Merlin's secrets and three great names; sought in the Stonehenge and Normandy Tribunals.

name: Stonehenge Tribunal
description: Hermetic Tribunal searched for the Book of Nimiane and home of the Woman of the Wheat Fields.

name: Normandy Tribunal
description: Hermetic Tribunal searched for the Book of Nimiane.

name: The Seekers
description: A secretive society of magi within the Order who search out artifacts; they claim the Book of Nimiane does not exist.

name: Cantation
description: A low-level formulaic spell, from the Latin cantamen (little spell), especially when cast by an apprentice; it usually succeeds.

name: Incantamen
description: Latin word Hermetic magi use for spells, meaning both formulaic and spontaneous.

name: The Apprentice's Delight
description: CrHe 3 cantation that creates a ripe apple lasting two minutes, sweet but not nourishing.

name: The Appropriate Attire
description: MuAn 4 cantation that changes the color and cut of leather, wool or fur clothing, giving +1 to Etiquette or Charm.

name: The Chameleon Cat
description: MuAn 5 cantation that changes a beast's color, even to unnatural colors; green cats are a favorite at Durenmar.

name: The Cleric's Pate
description: PeCo 5 cantation causing the target to lose all the hair on his head.

name: The Cook's Revenge
description: PeHe(An) 5 cantation that spoils a plate of food.

name: The Curse of Diana
description: PeAn 4 cantation that makes a small animal lose all its fur.

name: Curse of the Baby's Bladder
description: ReCo 4 cantation that makes the target release his water; unfortunately popular with apprentices.

name: Closing the Campfire
description: PeIg 5 cantation that extinguishes a fire the caster touches, popular with Flambeau apprentices.

name: The Dancer's Dame
description: ReHe 5 cantation animating a linen gown to dance with the caster.

name: Ears of the Hare
description: MuCo 4 cantation giving the caster a hare's hearing, +1 on hearing Perception rolls.

name: An Evening's Illumination
description: MuAq 5 cantation that changes water into lamp oil.

name: Hurling the Droplet of Lye
description: CrAq 3 cantation creating a drop of corrosive lye that can do +1 Damage.

name: Hypnotic Gaze
description: ReMe 5 cantation that makes the target fall asleep within seconds.

name: The Jongleur's Steps
description: ReAn 4 cantation animating a shoe to caper and jig, tripping its wearer.

name: Jupiter's Tears
description: CrAu 5 cantation making a single cloud release a light drizzle.

name: The Laundress' Clothesline
description: PeAq 4 cantation that immediately dries the caster's worn clothing.

name: Mimic the Christ's Miracle
description: MuAq 5 cantation changing water into a small amount of wine.

name: A Pestilence of Fleas
description: MuIm 4 sensory illusion making the target itchy, penalizing concentration and physical tasks by -1.

name: Physician's Sense
description: InCo 4 cantation that determines the general health of the caster.

name: The Physician's Eye
description: Spell referenced as the model for Physician's Sense, determining general health.

name: The Poor Performer's Reward
description: CrTe 4 cantation creating a handful of mud for hurling.

name: The Racing Rot
description: PeAn 4 cantation that cracks and wears leather goods.

name: The Reward Delivered
description: ReTe 4 counterpart to The Poor Performer's Reward that hurls the ball of mud at a target.

name: Sense the Sleeping Hound
description: InAn 5 cantation indicating whether an animal in range is asleep.

name: Shattering Touch
description: PeTe 5 spell breaking apart a stone object up to a pace across; known by the sample Verditius apprentice.

name: Slap of Awakening
description: ReMe 5 cantation that instantly awakens a sleeping target.

name: The Smokeless Campfire
description: MuIg 5 cantation making a fire produce no smoke.

name: The Studious Doppleganger
description: CrIm 5 cantation creating a visual static copy of the caster studying a book.

name: The Unruffled Traveler
description: ReAu 4 cantation warding the caster from light breezes.

name: Whispering Fingers
description: CrMe 5 cantation letting the caster speak directly into the target's mind.

name: Probe for Pure Gold
description: InTe 4 spell, a variant of Probe for Pure Silver, known by the sample Verditius apprentice.

name: Probe for Pure Silver
description: InTe spell of which Probe for Pure Gold is a variant.

name: The Crystal Dart
description: MuTe(Re) 10 spell known by the sample Verditius apprentice.

name: Ager Belli
description: CrIm 10 (Req Rego) illusion of a Roman soldier controlled by the caster, used by apprentices to play Bellum.

name: Durenmar
description: Covenant where green cats created with The Chameleon Cat are a favorite.

name: House Jerbiton
description: Hermetic House some of whose members find hairless cats beautiful; apprentices take a Grand Tour before their Gauntlet.

name: The Dream Witches
description: Evil sorceresses said to enter apprentices' dreams to create nightmares; they actually exist within an esoteric Mystery Cult of the Order.

name: Goblin
description: Traditional bogeyman used to frighten children.

name: Bugbear
description: Traditional bogeyman used to frighten children.

name: Elf
description: Traditional bogeyman used to frighten children.

name: Vampire
description: Traditional bogeyman used to frighten children.

name: Fourth Lateran Council
description: Church council whose Canon 50 requires marriages be performed by a priest.

name: Clandestine Marriage
description: Marriage without priest or witnesses, common but recently outlawed by the Church.

name: Jus Primae Noctis
description: The legend of the lord's right to a bride's first night, noted as not medieval.

name: Church
description: The Church, which regulates marriage and annulments.

name: Demon
description: Infernal beings that tempt adolescents toward sin.

name: Saint
description: Divine beings who favor adolescent petitioners (+1 to invoke a patron saint).

name: Unicorn
description: Creature that may be divine or magic; a magic unicorn might be calmed by a pure adolescent girl.

name: Phoenix
description: Divine creature that willingly assists the troubled.

name: Regio
description: A supernatural region; divine creatures, guardians and ghosts may dwell in regiones.

name: Troll
description: Faerie living under a bridge that challenges adolescents to inspire courage.

name: The Woman of the Wheat Fields
description: A nasty faerie of the Stonehenge Tribunal who abducts boys and removes their brains.

name: Griffin
description: Magic creature that views an adolescent as an easy meal.

name: Elemental
description: Unthinking magic thing that doesn't distinguish adolescents from adults.

name: Fachan
description: Faerie monster; a variant challenges young men to combat as a step to adulthood.

name: Faerie
description: Beings of the Faerie realm that feed on the vitality and emotion of adolescents.

name: Covenant
description: A community of magi where apprentices and grogs live.

name: Grog
description: Covenant soldiers and servants; their adolescents replace them in duties.

name: Companion
description: Non-magus player character type.

name: Covenfolk
description: The people living in a covenant.

name: Turb
description: The covenant's body of grogs.

name: Laboratory
description: The magus' working space; apprentices assist by adding Int + Magic Theory to the Lab Total.

name: Lab Total
description: The total used for laboratory activities, to which an apprentice assistant contributes.

name: Leadership
description: Ability needed to have more than one lab helper.

name: Inventive Genius
description: Virtue that adds to Lab Total.

name: Waster of Vis
description: Flaw doubling the vis cost of lab activities.

name: Shared Lab
description: A Free Outfitting laboratory Flaw for a lab too small for independent projects; -2 General Quality, -2 Safety.

name: Vis
description: Raw magical power used in lab work; apprentices can extract Vim vis.

name: Arcane Connection
description: A link to a person or place usable for magic; apprentices can fix them.

name: Refinement
description: Laboratory characteristic; a subpar lab has Refinement equal to Magic Theory - 3.

name: Familiar
description: Magical creature bound to a magus, such as a shapechanging cat.

name: Aegis of the Hearth
description: Covenant protective ritual that blocks Rego Corpus travel and could limit Turbulences.

name: Bellum
description: A game invented by Casius in the 10th century where apprentices duel with illusionary Roman soldiers via Ager Belli.

name: Casius
description: 10th-century magus who invented Bellum.

name: Finesse
description: Ability used in Bellum rolls.

name: Concentration
description: Ability to maintain spells; used in Bellum.

name: Oath of Hermes
description: Oath sworn to become a member of the Order; prerequisite for Parma Magica's final key.

name: Grand Tribunal
description: Order-wide Tribunal; at the Grand Tribunal of 1162 a Bellum game turned into a riot.

name: Redcap
description: Messengers of House Mercere.

name: Suppressed Gift
description: Major Hermetic Flaw where the Gift is suppressed but Supernatural Virtues still usable.

name: Amazon
description: Amazon sorceresses, whose tussling could cost an apprentice the Gift.

name: Blind
description: Flaw cited as an example chosen to define a character.

name: Missing Hand
description: Flaw cited as an example.

name: Tainted with Evil
description: Flaw cited as an example.

name: House Quaesitor
description: Magi who step in after three failed Gauntlets; Quaesitors can be notified of abuse.

name: Fenistal
description: Mock covenant in the Rhine Tribunal run by the Exsules, accepting abandoned apprentices.

name: Rhine Tribunal
description: Tribunal containing Fenistal, with rules of hospitality for young magi.

name: Exsules
description: Hermetic offshoots running Fenistal who accept Gifted abandoned apprentices.

name: Riddle of the Magus
description: Personal enigmatic puzzle given to Criamon apprentices marking them as magi.

name: House Guernicus
description: Legal-minded House whose apprentices take a written exam and mock investigation.

name: Grand Tour
description: Jerbiton pre-Gauntlet visit to a large city to view artifacts.

name: House Mercere
description: House of Redcaps; Gauntlet involves carrying a message.

name: House Tremere
description: House whose apprentices face their master in certamen and present a birch branch.

name: Certamen
description: Formalized magical duel used in Tremere Gauntlets.

name: Sigil
description: A magus' magical signature, symbolized by the birch branch in Tremere Gauntlets.

name: Apprentice Piece
description: Completed item a Verditius apprentice must forge for his Gauntlet.

name: Laboratory Text
description: Text Bonisagus apprentices must deliver before their Gauntlet.

name: Scholae Magicae
description: Schools of magic for training apprentices, mostly failed attempts since the 10th century.

name: Schism War
description: Hermetic war after which a covenant tried to form a Gifted academy.

name: Polyaigos
description: Island covenant in the Theban Tribunal running a school for Gifted children.

name: Theban Tribunal
description: Tribunal whose treatment of apprentices allows Polyaigos' school.

name: Scholomance
description: Mysterious school in the Transylvanian Tribunal teaching 10 students, only one Gifted.

name: Transylvanian Tribunal
description: Tribunal containing the Scholomance.

name: Monastery
description: Religious house; the Inheritance seed's monastery has Divine aura 4.

name: Creo
description: Hermetic Technique; abbreviated Cr in spell guidelines and apprentice statistics.

name: Intellego
description: Hermetic Technique; abbreviated In in spell guidelines and apprentice statistics.

name: Muto
description: Hermetic Technique; abbreviated Mu in spell guidelines and apprentice statistics.

name: Perdo
description: Hermetic Technique; abbreviated Pe in spell guidelines and apprentice statistics.

name: Rego
description: Hermetic Technique; abbreviated Re in spell guidelines and apprentice statistics.

name: Animal
description: Hermetic Form; abbreviated An in spell guidelines and apprentice statistics.

name: Aquam
description: Hermetic Form; abbreviated Aq in spell guidelines and apprentice statistics.

name: Auram
description: Hermetic Form; abbreviated Au in spell guidelines and apprentice statistics.

name: Corpus
description: Hermetic Form; abbreviated Co in spell guidelines and apprentice statistics.

name: Herbam
description: Hermetic Form; abbreviated He in spell guidelines and apprentice statistics.

name: Ignem
description: Hermetic Form; abbreviated Ig in spell guidelines and apprentice statistics.

name: Imaginem
description: Hermetic Form; abbreviated Im in spell guidelines and apprentice statistics.

name: Mentem
description: Hermetic Form; abbreviated Me in spell guidelines and apprentice statistics.

name: Terram
description: Hermetic Form; abbreviated Te in spell guidelines and apprentice statistics.

name: Vim
description: Hermetic Form; abbreviated Vi in spell guidelines and apprentice statistics.
